slides.heading: RULE OF THIRDS
slides.subheading: Place your subject on a third, not the center, unless you have a reason.

slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: The rule of thirds divides your frame into a 3×3 grid for natural balance.
Placing eyes, horizons, or key objects on the intersections creates tension and interest.
Use the opposite third for negative space to guide the viewer's eye.

slides.heading: THIRDS GRID
slides.caption: Place eyes and key elements on grid intersections—not dead center by habit.

slides.heading: HOW TO APPLY IT
steps: Place the subject on a vertical third.
Place eyes on a horizontal third.
Break the rule only with intention.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Use the opposite third for negative space to create direction.
